bibl.title: Ancora sullo Scriba A2 Johnson
bibl.seg: Lorenzo Sardone, Ancora sullo Scriba A2 Johnson.
bibl.note: P. Hamb. II, 146 (= MP3 2819; LDAB 46966), P. Mich. Inv. 1210 + 1216a (= MP3 904.1; LDAB 1973) and P. Mich. Inv. 1218 (= MP3 669.02; LDAB 1638) are three small papyrus fragments written in the II/III century AD by the scribe A2 Johnson in a calligraphic majuscule. The first one contains few lines of a Greek text, probably a speech of an Attic orator, while the second and the third report Homer, Iliad XIII.289-301 and II.744-754.
